Dear Madam
I am sorry to say your story did not come till the number had been chosen and sent to the printer.

It is very pretty, but here and there a little long.[^1]

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: Perhaps the Christmas Number of [MP](/periodical/52), for which the deadline was July.
